_help: Amy's TikTok videos, shown in the Videos section next to Instagram.

url: the share link (short tiktok.com/t/... links work). video_id: optional, the number in the full link tiktok.com/@amy.10007.st.charl/video/<NUMBER>. With a video_id the TikTok player loads directly; without it, the site asks TikTok for it in the visitor's browser and falls back to a 'Watch on TikTok' link.
home: true shows the video on the home page (up to 3).
